title: SightLine Test Fixture Page

findings.problem: Text contrast ratio 1.54:1 is below required minimum of 4.5:1.
findings.why_it_matters: Low contrast text makes content unreadable for users with low vision or in bright lighting.
findings.fix: Darken the text color to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

alternatives.label: Closest passing color
alternatives.description: Keep existing hue and adjust text lightness to satisfy WCAG AA contrast.
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves brand hue, but alters text lightness.

alternatives.label: Change the background instead
alternatives.description: Keep text color unchanged and adjust background lightness to pass contrast.
alternatives.tradeoff: Leaves text color untouched, but alters surrounding container background.

findings.problem: Interactive <button> element has no accessible name.
findings.why_it_matters: Screen readers announce interactive controls by name; without one, users cannot tell what the button does.
findings.fix: Add an aria-label attribute describing the button's action.
findings.evidence: Element #2 <button> has an empty accessible name

alternatives.label: Screen reader only text (.sr-only)
alternatives.description: Embed visually hidden text inside the control using standard utility CSS.
alternatives.fix_snippet: /* CSS */ .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
alternatives.tradeoff: Better compatibility across translation tools and legacy assistive tech, but requires extra markup and CSS.

findings.problem: Interactive target is smaller than 24x24 CSS pixels (10.0x10.0px).
findings.why_it_matters: Small tap targets cause frustrating misclicks on mobile touchscreens and hinder users with motor impairments.
findings.fix: Increase the interactive target size to at least 24x24 CSS pixels.
findings.evidence: Target size 10.0x10.0px is below WCAG 2.2 minimum 24x24px

alternatives.label: Expand padding with inline-flex
alternatives.description: Increase touch target by adding padding and centered alignment.
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves inner icon proportions, but increases outer spacing.

alternatives.label: Invisible pseudo-element hit area
alternatives.description: Expand clickable area with an invisible ::after pseudo-element.
alternatives.tradeoff: Zero layout shift on surrounding items, but pseudo-elements may overlap nearby links.

issues.site-001:
## [MEDIUM] Low contrast on paragraph text

### Problem
Text contrast ratio 1.54:1 is below required minimum of 4.5:1.

### Fix
```css
color: #111827;
```
issues.site-002:
## [HIGH] Icon button missing accessible name

### Problem
Interactive `<button>` has no accessible name.

### Fix
```html
<button class="planted-icon-button" aria-label="Settings">
```
issues.site-003:
## [MEDIUM] Link target smaller than 24x24px

### Problem
Interactive target is 10.0x10.0px, below WCAG 2.2 minimum.

### Fix
```css
min-width: 24px;
min-height: 24px;
```
